article.title: Norman Finkelstein’s latest book indicts those ‘in high places’ for genocide in Gaza
article.author: Editor
article.content: A review of Norman Finkelstein's 'Gaza's Gravediggers,' which indicts not Israel's military, but the global officials and institutions, such as the UN, the ICJ, and the media, who enabled and legitimized the genocide. The post Norman Finkelstein’s latest book indicts those ‘in high places’ for genocide in Gaza appeared first on MR Online .
